relations.subject: Hans-Ulrich Rieker
relations.evidence: Ordained as Buddhist monk in 1952 at Anagarika Govinda’s Arya Maitreya Mandala and founded its Berlin branch.

relations.subject: Hans-Ulrich Rieker
relations.evidence: He was then its leader until 1964, when he had to retire because of health problems (progressive deafness).
